cards.example_en: Wrap the gift in red paper.
cards.example_zh: 用红纸把礼物包起来。

cards.example_en: He had to wrestle with a difficult question.
cards.example_zh: 他不得不努力对付一道难题。

cards.example_en: A wrinkle showed on the old map.
cards.example_zh: 旧地图上有一条褶皱。

cards.example_en: She wore a watch on her wrist.
cards.example_zh: 她手腕上戴着手表。

cards.example_en: The writer signed my book after the library talk.
cards.example_zh: 图书馆讲座结束后，那位作家给我的书签了名。

cards.example_en: Cars must drive slowly in the school zone near the gate.
cards.example_zh: 车辆在校门附近的学校地带必须慢速行驶。

cards.example_en: An Afghan student joined our class last term.
cards.example_zh: 上学期一位阿富汗学生加入了我们班。

cards.example_en: Afghanistan is a mountainous country in Asia.
cards.example_zh: 阿富汗是亚洲的一个多山国家。

cards.example_en: Algeria lies on the southern coast of the Mediterranean.
cards.example_zh: 阿尔及利亚位于地中海的南岸。

cards.meaning_zh: 阿尔及利亚人；阿尔及利亚的
cards.example_en: The Algerian runner won the long-distance race.
cards.example_zh: 那位阿尔及利亚选手赢得了长跑。

cards.example_en: Argentina is well known for football and beef.
cards.example_zh: 阿根廷以足球和牛肉闻名。

cards.example_en: We watched an Argentinian film in the culture club.
cards.example_zh: 我们在文化社看了一部阿根廷电影。

cards.example_en: Austria is famous for music and mountain towns.
cards.example_zh: 奥地利以音乐和山城闻名。

cards.example_en: The Austrian pianist played at our school hall.
cards.example_zh: 那位奥地利钢琴家在学校礼堂演出。

cards.example_en: Belgian chocolate is sold in the airport shop.
cards.example_zh: 机场商店里卖比利时巧克力。

cards.example_en: My pen friend lives in Belgium with her family.
cards.example_zh: 我的笔友和家人一起住在比利时。

cards.example_en: My cousin studies football in Brazil this year.
cards.example_zh: 我表哥今年在巴西学足球。

cards.example_en: The Brazilian captain scored twice in the final.
cards.example_zh: 巴西队长在决赛中进了两个球。

cards.example_en: A Briton in the hotel helped us read the menu.
cards.example_zh: 酒店里一位英国人帮我们看了菜单。

cards.example_en: She is learning a few Burmese phrases before the trip.
cards.example_zh: 旅行前她在学几句缅甸语。

cards.example_en: Colombia exports coffee to many countries.
cards.example_zh: 哥伦比亚向许多国家出口咖啡。

cards.meaning_zh: 哥伦比亚人；哥伦比亚的
cards.example_en: Our Colombian partner school sent us a video.
cards.example_zh: 我们的哥伦比亚姊妹学校给我们发来一段视频。

cards.example_en: Cuba is an island country in the Caribbean.
cards.example_zh: 古巴是加勒比海的一个岛国。

cards.example_en: We heard Cuban music at the city festival.
cards.example_zh: 我们在城市音乐节上听到了古巴音乐。

cards.example_en: DPRK is the short name for North Korea.
cards.example_zh: DPRK 是朝鲜的英文简称。

cards.example_en: The Dane sitting next to me is an exchange student.
cards.example_zh: 坐在我旁边的丹麦人是交换生。

cards.example_en: Danish design is simple, with clean lines.
cards.example_zh: 丹麦设计简洁，线条干净。

cards.example_en: My pen friend in Denmark sent a photo of her snowy school.
cards.example_zh: 我在丹麦的笔友寄来一张她学校下雪的照片。

cards.example_en: We tried Dutch cheese at the food stall beside the river.
cards.example_zh: 我们在河边的食品摊品尝了荷兰奶酪。

cards.example_en: The postcard from Egypt shows pyramids under a very blue sky.
cards.example_zh: 从埃及寄来的明信片上，金字塔衬着很蓝的天空。

cards.example_en: The museum has an Egyptian mummy behind glass.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆的玻璃后面有一具埃及木乃伊。

cards.example_en: Our Filipino friend taught us a harvest dance.
cards.example_zh: 我们的菲律宾朋友教了我们一支丰收舞。

cards.example_en: Finland is known for forests, lakes, and good schools.
cards.example_zh: 芬兰以森林、湖泊和好学校闻名。

cards.example_en: The Finn in the science camp spoke three languages.
cards.example_zh: 科学营里的那位芬兰人会说三种语言。

cards.example_en: Finnish winters are long and very dark.
cards.example_zh: 芬兰的冬天又长又黑。

cards.example_en: A Frenchman in the market showed us how to choose cheese.
cards.example_zh: 市场里一位法国男人教我们怎么挑奶酪。

cards.example_en: The Frenchwoman leading the tour spoke clear English.
cards.example_zh: 带队的法国女人英语说得很清楚。

cards.example_en: We climbed white steps above the sea in Greece.
cards.example_zh: 我们在希腊爬上海边的白色石阶。

cards.example_en: Greek salad was the most popular dish at the food fair.
cards.example_zh: 希腊沙拉是美食节上最受欢迎的菜。

cards.example_en: Windmills still turn in the flat fields of Holland.
cards.example_zh: 荷兰平坦的田野上，风车仍在转动。

cards.example_en: The Hungarian student won the maths contest.
cards.example_zh: 那位匈牙利学生赢了数学竞赛。

cards.example_en: Hungary sits in the middle of Europe.
cards.example_zh: 匈牙利位于欧洲中部。

cards.example_en: Indonesia is made up of thousands of islands.
cards.example_zh: 印度尼西亚由数千个岛屿组成。

cards.meaning_zh: 印度尼西亚人；印度尼西亚的
cards.example_en: Indonesian food in that cafe is spicy and sweet.
cards.example_zh: 那家咖啡馆的印尼菜又辣又甜。

cards.example_en: Saffron from Iran scented the rice at the food stall.
cards.example_zh: 食摊上的米饭带着从伊朗带来的藏红花香味。

cards.example_en: An Iranian poet's lines were printed in our textbook.
cards.example_zh: 我们课本里印了一位伊朗诗人的诗句。

cards.example_en: Iraq lies between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers.
cards.example_zh: 伊拉克位于底格里斯河和幼发拉底河之间。

cards.example_en: The Iraqi boy in the photo is holding a kite.
cards.example_zh: 照片里的伊拉克男孩拿着一只风筝。

cards.example_en: Stone walls divide the green fields across Ireland.
cards.example_zh: 石墙把爱尔兰的绿色田野一块块分开。

cards.example_en: My cousin studies Irish dancing on Saturday afternoons.
cards.example_zh: 我表姐每个星期六下午学爱尔兰舞。
